title: PTFE coaxial line, conductors of radii 1 and 3.5 mm, 10 mm long, its ports' modes solved on the annulus: TEM transmission
source: A two-conductor line of one homogeneous dielectric carries a TEM wave with β = k0 √εr whatever the shape of its cross-section, so S21 = exp(−jβL) and S11 = 0 for a uniform length (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §2.2, §3.5)

quantities.reason: 2 mm tetrahedra, those on the conductors curved, and the ports' triangles curved with them: −0.004°
lossless: power is conserved; |S21| moves only by the small reflection
the numerical TEM mode in the volume's own trace space: 6e-5 (straight port triangles in the curved guide: 5e-3)
as at 3 GHz, half the wavelength: −0.008°
